passages.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners, to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of our God’s vengeance, to comfort all who mourn, to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.
passages.sermon:
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me.
The LORD has anointed Me.
He chose Me to preach good news to the poor.
He sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted.
He sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives.
He sent Me to proclaim freedom to the prisoners.
He sent Me to announce the year of the LORD’s favor.
He sent Me to announce the day of our God’s vengeance.
He sent Me to comfort all who mourn.
He sent Me to console the mourners in Zion.
He will give them a crown of beauty instead of ashes.
He will give them the oil of joy instead of mourning.
He will give them a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair.
People will call them oaks of righteousness.
The LORD has planted them.
He will be glorified through them.
passages.original: ר֛וּחַ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה עָלָ֑י יַ֡עַן מָשַׁח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לְבַשֵּׂ֣ר עֲנָוִ֗ים שְׁלָחַ֙נִי֙ לַחֲבֹ֣שׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־ לֵ֔ב לִקְרֹ֤א לִשְׁבוּיִם֙ דְּר֔וֹר וְלַאֲסוּרִ֖ים פְּקַח־ קֽוֹחַ׃ לִקְרֹ֤א שְׁנַת־ רָצוֹן֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְי֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לֵאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְנַחֵ֖ם כָּל־ אֲבֵלִֽים׃ לָשׂ֣וּם׀ לַאֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן לָתֵת֩ לָהֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר שֶׁ֤מֶן שָׂשׂוֹן֙ תַּ֣חַת אֵ֔בֶל מַעֲטֵ֣ה תְהִלָּ֔ה תַּ֖חַת ר֣וּחַ כֵּהָ֑ה וְקֹרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֵילֵ֣י הַצֶּ֔דֶק מַטַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃

passages.text: They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities, the desolations of many generations.
passages.sermon:
They will rebuild the ancient ruins.
They will restore the places that have been devastated for a long time.
They will renew the ruined cities.
These cities have been desolate for many generations.
passages.original: וּבָנוּ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם שֹׁמְמ֥וֹת רִֽאשֹׁנִ֖ים יְקוֹמֵ֑מוּ וְחִדְּשׁוּ֙ עָ֣רֵי חֹ֔רֶב שֹׁמְמ֖וֹת דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners will be your plowmen and vinedressers.
passages.sermon:
Strangers will stand among you.
Strangers will feed your flocks.
Foreigners will work as your plowmen.
Foreigners will tend your vineyards.
passages.original: וְעָמְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים וְרָע֖וּ צֹאנְכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵיכֶ֖ם וְכֹרְמֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But you will be called the priests of the LORD; they will speak of you as ministers of our God; you will feed on the wealth of nations, and you will boast in their riches.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God calls His people priests of the LORD.
People will call them ministers of our God.
God’s people will eat the wealth of nations.
God’s people will boast in the riches of other nations.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם כֹּהֲנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ תִּקָּרֵ֔אוּ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ יֵאָמֵ֖ר לָכֶ֑ם חֵ֤יל גּוֹיִם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וּבִכְבוֹדָ֖ם תִּתְיַמָּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: Instead of shame, My people will have a double portion, and instead of humiliation, they will rejoice in their share; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God’s people once felt shame.
God will give them a double portion instead of shame.
God’s people once felt humiliation.
God’s people will rejoice in their share instead of humiliation.
God will give them a double portion in their land.
God’s people will have everlasting joy.
passages.original: תַּ֤חַת בָּשְׁתְּכֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה וּכְלִמָּ֖ה יָרֹ֣נּוּ חֶלְקָ֑ם לָכֵ֤ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֣ה יִירָ֔שׁוּ שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks here.
The LORD loves justice.
The LORD hates robbery.
The LORD hates wrongdoing.
The LORD acts with faithfulness.
The LORD will give His people what they deserve.
The LORD will make an everlasting covenant with them.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֹהֵ֣ב מִשְׁפָּ֔ט שֹׂנֵ֥א גָזֵ֖ל בְּעוֹלָ֑ה וְנָתַתִּ֤י פְעֻלָּתָם֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת וּבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם אֶכְר֥וֹת לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.
passages.sermon:
God blesses His people.
Their children will be known among all nations.
Their descendants will be recognized among all peoples.
Everyone who sees them will know this.
People will see that the LORD has blessed them.
passages.original: וְנוֹדַ֤ע בַּגּוֹיִם֙ זַרְעָ֔ם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעַמִּ֑ים כָּל־ רֹֽאֵיהֶם֙ יַכִּיר֔וּם כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע בֵּרַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
passages.sermon:
I am the speaker in this passage.
I will rejoice greatly in the LORD.
My soul will exult in my God.
The LORD has clothed me with garments of salvation.
He has wrapped me in a robe of righteousness.
A bridegroom wears a priestly headdress.
A bride adorns herself with her jewels.
The LORD has dressed me in this way.
passages.original: שׂ֧וֹשׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽיהוָ֗ה תָּגֵ֤ל נַפְשִׁי֙ בֵּֽאלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י הִלְבִּישַׁ֙נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי־ יֶ֔שַׁע מְעִ֥יל צְדָקָ֖ה יְעָטָ֑נִי כֶּֽחָתָן֙ יְכַהֵ֣ן פְּאֵ֔ר וְכַכַּלָּ֖ה תַּעְדֶּ֥ה כֵלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD acts with power and purpose.
The earth brings forth its own growth.
A garden causes its seeds to spring up.
In the same way, the Lord GOD will cause righteousness to grow.
He will also cause praise to rise up.
This will happen before all the nations.
Everyone will see righteousness and praise appear.
passages.original: כִּ֤י כָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תּוֹצִ֣יא צִמְחָ֔הּ וּכְגַנָּ֖ה זֵרוּעֶ֣יהָ תַצְמִ֑יחַ כֵּ֣ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ צְדָקָה֙ וּתְהִלָּ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
